🎥🎬: No Time to Die (2021)

James Bond has left active service and is enjoying a quieter life in Jamaica when his old friend Felix Leiter arrives with a dangerous request. A mission to rescue a kidnapped scientist soon pulls Bond into a conspiracy far more complicated than he expected.

His investigation leads him to Safin, a mysterious adversary armed with a devastating biological weapon capable of targeting specific people. As Bond uncovers the truth, he must confront old enemies, uncertain loyalties, and secrets connected to Madeleine Swann.

With the fate of millions at stake, Bond races to stop Safin’s plan while facing the personal cost of the life he has chosen. His final mission becomes a battle of sacrifice, love, and duty that changes the legacy of 007 forever.
